defaults.permitted_development: Across West Sussex, domestic solar panels are usually easiest on the planning permission route when they sit close to the roof or wall, stay visually secondary to the building and avoid awkward heritage or frontage impacts. rules.boundary_rules: Boundary-facing arrays, visible side elevations and garden-based equipment usually deserve a closer amenity and visual check across West Sussex.
rules.roof_rules: The easiest solar schemes usually follow the roof plane cleanly and avoid sensitive, highly visible or heritage-affected roof slopes.
rules.materials_rules: Panels, inverters and associated equipment should be designed as one tidy appearance-led package rather than as separate add-ons scattered around the building.
